title: Touch Weather Station

hardware.candidate: ESP32-S3 3.5-inch capacitive-touch board; exact purchased controller and PCB revision unresolved

supplementaryRequirements: No case for the MAKHEX 3.5-inch PCB is qualified; upstream 4-inch case is not plug-compatible.

tests.name: Record shipped PCB markings, display/touch controller IDs and schematic revision
tests.procedure: Photograph front/back; reconcile accessible GPIO and 3V3 rail
tests.acceptance: All controller identifiers, pin mappings and voltage limits recorded

tests.name: Detect exact BME280 before enabling dashboard
tests.procedure: Read chip ID and calibrated temp/RH/pressure over mapped I2C
tests.acceptance: Chip ID 0x60 and three valid values; fail instead of substituting BMP280

tests.name: Verify display and touch on a matched driver
tests.procedure: Render touch targets and capture serial initialization logs
tests.acceptance: Every target can be selected without invalid pixels or unregistered presses

tests.name: Run a 30-minute touch and sensor soak
tests.procedure: Log timestamp, values, touch count, heap and faults
tests.acceptance: No lockup, values timestamped, sustained touch response

tests.name: Unplug sensor while powered only if breakout connection is designed for hotplug; otherwise power-cycle with disconnected sensor
tests.procedure: Observe UI stale-data behavior and error log
tests.acceptance: No fabricated reading; explicit disconnected or stale indication
